_comment: The SHAPE v11 — the drop is RESTORED. v10 (never actually heard: it sat in the working tree while the built page was still the older build) tried to fix 'no bass in the drop' by thinning it — one `bassline` in place of rollbass+ronsub, no hookrun, no hookdeep, and DROP II deleted outright. Heard side by side against the older build, the fuller drop wins, so v11 puts back the last committed pair exactly: THE DROP (4 bars, 9 layers) + DROP II — the hook doubles down (4 bars, 11 layers, chiparp + shimmerhat). `bassline` stays in palette.json, unused, if it is ever wanted in place of rollbass+ronsub. Everything else is v10: no narration (both lines now live in id/nature-was-a-gift/ and id/all-good-things/), the 2-bar instrumental where the opening line used to be, and the exhale/cadenza album bridge untouched.
